bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81sl_cap_ld #(.D(16)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay_rf.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_cap_ld.sv && echo lint-ok

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_ld/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_ld/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_ld --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81sl_cap_ld  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: LEAD2-S81/TOK2 10-19 TOK.DS.BENCH.1: NEW leaf ot_s81sl_cap_ld (static 70-b lane delay D=16 on W lane 3 = R01 before u_tw): the W tree carries four QF frames, so the E-only delay cannot pack; exact repack s_16_24 (W lane 3 +16, E +24) and the fullsix l16e24 rerun show no tree fault (only the expected reset-CAP F9). ot_hdc_delay_rf 70 x 14 = 980 b, primed valid. +16 edges on R01 words.
